Scholarship_Value: จำนวนรวม 10 ทุน มูลค่าสูงสุดทุนละ 1.67 ล้านบาท (ทุนเต็มจำนวน) ครอบคลุมค่าธรรมเนียมการศึกษา ค่าอาหารกลางวัน ค่าแรกเข้า ค่าบำรุงการศึกษา ค่าหอพัก และค่าเครื่องแต่งกายแรกเข้า

University: Assumption College (อัสสัมชัญบางรัก สามัญ)
Scholarship: โครงการนักกีฬาทุนโรงเรียนอัสสัมชัญ
Scholarship_Type: ทุนความสามารถพิเศษด้านกีฬา (ทุนนักกีฬา)
Conditions: นักเรียน/ผู้มีความสามารถพิเศษด้านกีฬาตามโครงการของโรงเรียน (รายละเอียดตามที่โรงเรียนกำหนด)
Scholarship_Value: ไม่ระบุรายละเอียดมูลค่าบนหน้าเว็บไซต์โรงเรียน

University: Assumption College (อัสสัมชัญบางรัก EP/SMEP)
Scholarship: โครงการนักกีฬาทุนโรงเรียนอัสสัมชัญ
Scholarship_Type: ทุนความสามารถพิเศษด้านกีฬา (ทุนนักกีฬา)
Conditions: นักเรียน/ผู้มีความสามารถพิเศษด้านกีฬาตามโครงการของโรงเรียน (รายละเอียดตามที่โรงเรียนกำหนด)
Scholarship_Value: ไม่ระบุรายละเอียดมูลค่าบนหน้าเว็บไซต์โรงเรียน

University: Sarasas Ektra (สารสาส์นเอกตรา)
Scholarship: ทุนการศึกษา (Scholarship) สำหรับนักเรียนชั้น Year 6 และ Year 9
Scholarship_Type: Merit (ทุนความสามารถ) – แบ่งเป็น 3 ประเภท
Conditions: มอบให้นักเรียนชั้น Year 6 และ Year 9 ที่มีความประสงค์จะศึกษาต่อกับทางโรงเรียนในระดับชั้นมัธยมศึกษาตอนต้นและตอนปลาย โดยแบ่งทุนออกเป็น 3 ประเภท คือ 1) ทุนความสามารถด้านภาษาอังกฤษ 2) ทุนความสามารถด้านวิชาการ 3) ทุนความสามารถด้านดนตรี
Scholarship_Value: ทุนการศึกษา (หมายเหตุ: ในแต่ละปี รายละเอียดและประเภทของทุนการศึกษาอาจมีการเปลี่ยนแปลง)

University: NIST International School
Scholarship: IB Excellence Scholarships
Scholarship_Type: Academic merit
Conditions: Awarded to students with high academic potential; both internal and external applicants accepted.
Scholarship_Value: Merit-based fee reduction (partial tuition)

University: Bangkok Patana School
Scholarship: Academic and IB Awards
Scholarship_Type: Academic merit
Conditions: Available for Years 10–13; reviewed annually by the school's scholarship panel.
Scholarship_Value: Partial tuition fee reduction (merit-based)

University: Harrow International School Bangkok
Scholarship: Academic Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Academic merit
Conditions: Awarded to students entering Harrow Bangkok (available for Year 9 and above) who demonstrate high academic ability, measured by an entrance test, specific subject tests, prior academic records and interview/s with senior staff.
Scholarship_Value: Monetary reward (reduction of school fees)

University: Harrow International School Bangkok
Scholarship: Sixth Form Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Academic merit (Sixth Form)
Conditions: Awarded to students progressing to, or entering, the Sixth Form with an outstanding record of GCSE/IGCSE results. Award criteria (A*=2 points, A=1 point): Gold 16 points, Silver 12 points, Bronze 8 points.
Scholarship_Value: Monetary reward / fee reduction (Gold/Silver/Bronze tiers); new entrants meeting criteria gain scholar title without monetary award

University: Harrow International School Bangkok
Scholarship: Creative & Performing Arts and Sports Scholarships
Scholarship_Type: Talent (Music/Art/Drama; Sport)
Conditions: CPA scholarships (Drama, Art, Music) for Year 6 and above require a portfolio and audition/interview; music applicants typically need ABRSM grade 6–7 on first instrument. Sports scholarships for Year 6 and above normally require national honours in the chosen sport.
Scholarship_Value: Monetary reward (fee reduction)

University: Shrewsbury International School Bangkok
Scholarship: Sixth Form Entrance Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Academic merit (Sixth Form)
Conditions: For exceptional students applying to join the A Level programme (Year 12); applicants sit entrance tests in four intended A Level subjects and interview; expectations at the level of internal Sir Martin Rees Scholars (typically 11+ A* grades at IGCSE).
Scholarship_Value: Tuition fee remission (amount agreed per case by the Executive Board, reviewed after a year)

University: Shrewsbury International School Bangkok
Scholarship: Music Scholarship (and Performance Scholarship)
Scholarship_Type: Talent (Music / Performance e.g. sport)
Conditions: Music Scholarships for internal and external applicants demonstrating ABRSM Diploma-standard ability on main instrument; encouraged to apply before end of Year 10. Performance Scholarships may be awarded to students with track records of local/regional/national/international success in a discipline such as sport.
Scholarship_Value: Fee remission attached to the award

University: Wellington College Bangkok
Scholarship: Governors' Scholarships (Academic, Sports, Music)
Scholarship_Type: Merit (Academic, Sport, Music)
Conditions: Open to current Wellington students and external applicants from other international/Thai schools. Academic: entering Year 9, 10, 12, normally mean CAT score 118+. Sports: Year 7+, competing at regional/national/international level (primarily Golf, Swimming, Tennis). Music: entering Year 7, 9 or 12, typically Grade 8 main instrument and Grade 5 Theory.
Scholarship_Value: Up to 70% remission of tuition fees

University: Brighton College Bangkok
Scholarship: Academic Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Academic merit
Conditions: For external pupils entering Year 9 (IGCSE) or Year 11 (A Level); awarded based on performance on Scholarship Day. Scholars are intellectually curious, motivated pupils who contribute positively as senior school role models.
Scholarship_Value: 5%–40% tuition fee remission (depending on assessment outcomes)

University: Brighton College Bangkok
Scholarship: Music and Sports Scholarships
Scholarship_Type: Talent (Music; Sport)
Conditions: Available for pupils from Year 4 to Year 11, with two awards offered at each key stage (Upper Key Stage 2 to Key Stage 5). Music applicants must show strong instrumental/vocal ability supported by ABRSM, Trinity or equivalent. Sports applicants must demonstrate high-level performance in at least one sport at local, national or international level.
Scholarship_Value: Tuition fee remission

University: Regent's International School Bangkok
Scholarship: Global Connect Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Academic merit / international
Conditions: For highly academic international students with outstanding references from their Heads or Principals; applicants assessed and interviewed in their own country. Scheme has run for 20 years.
Scholarship_Value: Awards can be as large as 30% of fees and boarding fee

University: Regent's International School Bangkok
Scholarship: Music Scholarship (and other sponsorship awards: Bhutanese, Nation Rebuilding, Diplomatic Connect)
Scholarship_Type: Talent (Music) / sponsored awards
Conditions: Music Scholars awarded on the basis of auditions or recorded performances from overseas applicants. School also offers Bhutanese Scholars (selected by HM the King of Bhutan's mother), Nation Rebuilding Scholarship, and Diplomatic Connect Programme (for children of ambassadors/expat diplomats).
Scholarship_Value: Scholarship / fee reduction (subject to Board approval of the Principal's recommendation)

University: Regents International School Pattaya
Scholarship: Signature Scholarships (Academic Excellence, Sport, Arts/Music, Service, All-Rounder)
Scholarship_Type: Merit / talent scholarship (fee remission)
Conditions: For students with exceptional academic ability, talent in arts or sport, or commitment to service. Awarded for one year (Academic Excellence up to two years). Apply via online application form; limited number available each year.
Scholarship_Value: 3 Stars: 100%; 2 Stars: 50%; 1 Star: 25%; Junior: 5-20% scholarship

University: KIS International School
Scholarship: KIS IB Diploma Programme Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Academic full scholarship (means/merit)
Conditions: Full IB Diploma scholarships for Grades 11-12. Six full scholarships worth over THB 10,000,000 awarded across the group (two at KIS Bangkok, four at KIS Reignwood Park). Aimed at talented students who may not otherwise access IB education.
Scholarship_Value: 100% (full tuition for the two-year IB Diploma); 6 awards worth over THB 10 million in total

University: Concordian International School
Scholarship: Concordian Scholarship (Grade 10 & IB Diploma Programme)
Scholarship_Type: Full & partial merit scholarship
Conditions: Open to students entering Grade 10 (MYP) and Grade 11 (IB Diploma) who demonstrate a passion for excellence, leadership and social responsibility. Applicants must submit completed application and essay.
Scholarship_Value: Full and partial scholarships (percentage not publicly specified)

University: Bromsgrove International School Thailand
Scholarship: BIST Scholarships (Academic, Creative Talent, Sporting Talent)
Scholarship_Type: Merit / talent scholarship
Conditions: Three categories. Academic: strong track record (Sixth Form entry needs predicted min. 7 A/A* IGCSE). Creative Talent: outstanding talent in music/performing arts (music min. ABRSM Grade 5). Sporting Talent: regional/national level achievement. Open to existing and new students; assessment, audition/trial and interview required.
Scholarship_Value: Fee remission (percentage not publicly specified)

University: Rugby School Thailand
Scholarship: Rugby School Thailand Scholarships (Academic, Art, Drama, Music, Design & Technology, Sport)
Scholarship_Type: Merit / talent scholarship (fee remission)
Conditions: Entry as a scholar in Years 7, 8, 9, 10 or 12 (ages 11-16). Awards recognise exceptional achievement; require admissions assessment plus subject tests, portfolio, audition/trial and interview. Sports include swimming, football, basketball, rugby, tennis, golf, volleyball, athletics.
Scholarship_Value: Fee remission of up to 20% on both tuition and boarding fees

University: Berkeley International School
Scholarship: Berkeley Merit-Based Scholarship (High School)
Scholarship_Type: Merit scholarship
Conditions: Exclusively for new High School students (Grades 9-12). Criteria include outstanding academic performance, English language proficiency, and exceptional talent in a sport or academic discipline.
Scholarship_Value: Merit-based award (percentage not publicly specified)

University: Verso International School
Scholarship: VERSO Talent Scholarship & VERSO Ambassador Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Talent / merit scholarship
Conditions: For highly talented students in academics, arts, sports, technology and leadership. Ambassador Scholarship for Grades 9-11; Talent Scholarship for Grades 5-11. Applicants may apply for both.
Scholarship_Value: Ambassador: 100% tuition Year 1, 70% Years 2-4. Talent: 70% tuition Year 1, 40% Years 2-4 (per published 2022-23 programme)

University: Denla British School (DBS)
Scholarship: Pandejpong Awards (Sixth Form full scholarship)
Scholarship_Type: Academic full scholarship
Conditions: For high-achieving Year 11 students entering Sixth Form (Years 12-13). UK system: min. 8 IGCSE subjects at A/A*; other systems: straight A in Year 9 or GPAX 3.80+. Selection via standardised tests, thinking skills assessment and panel interview.
Scholarship_Value: 100% tuition fee waiver for Years 12-13 (valued up to THB 2 million) plus waiver of THB 220,000 registration fee and a scholarship package up to THB 250,000

University: Denla British School (DBS)
Scholarship: DBS Scholarships (Academic, Music, Sports, Innovation & Creativity, Leadership)
Scholarship_Type: Merit / talent scholarship
Conditions: Awarded across Academic and Enhanced British Curriculum categories for outstanding talent in chosen field. Scholars receive a personal development fund, mentoring, specialist development and university support; expected to act as role models. Apply via Scholarship Enquiry Form.
Scholarship_Value: Includes a scholar development fund (cash benefit) and tailored support; tuition percentage not publicly specified

University: King's College International School Bangkok
Scholarship: King's Bangkok Academic Excellence Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Academic full scholarship (needs-aware)
Conditions: For academically outstanding students entering Year 10 or Year 12 (2026/27), designed to widen access for highly able students who would otherwise face significant financial barriers. Support continues until graduation in Year 13.
Scholarship_Value: Full fee remission plus uniform, learning equipment and devices; additional THB 1 million towards university studies upon securing a university place

University: St. Andrews International School Bangkok
Scholarship: St Andrews Sukhumvit 107 (S107) Scholarships
Scholarship_Type: Merit / talent scholarship (fee remission)
Conditions: Open to English-speaking students from international and Thai schools entering Year 9 and above who achieve high academic results or have particular skills in creative arts. Application includes assessment.
Scholarship_Value: Awards vary from 5% up to 50% of tuition fees

University: Wells International School
Scholarship: Wells Incoming Scholarships (Academics, Sports, Arts)
Scholarship_Type: Merit / talent scholarship
Conditions: Secondary students applying to Wells may qualify for incoming scholarships for excellence in academics, sports or the arts.
Scholarship_Value: Over THB 1.5 million in scholarships awarded to high-achieving students every year (individual award percentage not publicly specified)

University: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)
Scholarship: MIT Scholarship (need-based grant)
Scholarship_Type: Need-based grant; need-blind for all including international
Conditions: Awarded on the basis of demonstrated financial need only; no separate application beyond the CSS Profile; renewed yearly with continued need. MIT is need-blind and meets full need for all undergraduates, domestic and international.
Scholarship_Value: Meets 100% of demonstrated need; grant does not need to be repaid. Median MIT Scholarship around $69,777 (2024-25); from 2025-26 families earning under $200,000 typically attend tuition-free.

University: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)
Scholarship: MIT Need-Blind Admissions Policy
Scholarship_Type: Need-blind admission policy (international eligible)
Conditions: Admissions process is need-blind for all students, foreign and domestic; financial need is not a factor in the admission decision. MIT provides aid on the basis of financial need only and offers no merit/athletic scholarships.
Scholarship_Value: Removes ability to pay as an admission factor; aid is purely need-based.

University: Harvard University
Scholarship: Harvard Griffin Financial Aid (need-based scholarship)
Scholarship_Type: Need-based grant; need-blind including international
Conditions: Financial aid is available to foreign students on exactly the same basis as for American students; foreign students are not eligible for U.S. federal funding but Harvard provides its own job and scholarship money. Application instructions apply to all students regardless of citizenship.
Scholarship_Value: Need-based aid; about 24% of students pay nothing to attend and more than half receive need-based scholarships. Meets 100% of demonstrated need.

University: Stanford University
Scholarship: Stanford Need-Based Financial Aid (international)
Scholarship_Type: Need-based grant; need-aware for international applicants
Conditions: Must indicate request for aid on the admission application; international applicants requesting aid are reviewed need-aware (request may affect admission). International students who do not request aid at application cannot apply later. No merit scholarships except a limited number of athletic awards.
Scholarship_Value: Meets full demonstrated need of all admitted students regardless of citizenship through institutional grants/scholarships.

University: California Institute of Technology (Caltech)
Scholarship: Caltech Need-Based Financial Aid (international)
Scholarship_Type: Need-based grant; need-aware for international applicants
Conditions: International students must apply for aid as an incoming first-year; if not applied for or not qualified as a first-year, cannot apply in later years. No aid for international transfer/3-2 applicants. International students not eligible for U.S. federal aid. Requires CSS Profile, parents' tax return and Caltech Scholarship Data Form.
Scholarship_Value: Need-based institutional aid covering cost of attendance based on demonstrated need (grants from institutional/endowed funds).

University: Princeton University
Scholarship: Princeton Financial Aid (need-based grant)
Scholarship_Type: Need-based grant; need-blind including international
Conditions: Admission is need-blind with no disadvantage for aid applicants; Princeton applies the same financial aid policy to international students. Determined using Princeton's own simplified formula.
Scholarship_Value: Meets 100% of demonstrated financial need with grant aid (no loans). The average grant covers 100% of tuition; about 90% of recent seniors graduate debt-free.

University: Yale University
Scholarship: Yale Scholarship (need-based grant)
Scholarship_Type: Need-based grant; need-blind including international
Conditions: Need-blind admissions apply to both U.S. and international students; aid awarded as need-based Yale Scholarship grants with a small term-time work expectation. Yale was the first private research university to establish need-blind admission and need-based aid. Requires CSS Profile.
Scholarship_Value: Meets 100% of demonstrated need entirely with grants (no loans). Families earning under about $75,000 typically pay $0.

University: Columbia University
Scholarship: Columbia Need-Based Financial Aid (international)
Scholarship_Type: Need-based grant; need-aware for international applicants
Conditions: All financial aid is need-based; no merit scholarships for academics, athletics or talents. International applicants are evaluated need-aware (committee considers how much aid a student requires). International aid totaled about $19 million for 2023-2024.
Scholarship_Value: Meets 100% of the demonstrated need of all admitted first-year students regardless of citizenship.

University: University of Pennsylvania (UPenn)
Scholarship: Penn Grant-Based Financial Aid (international)
Scholarship_Type: Need-based grant (no-loan); need-aware for international applicants
Conditions: Penn's grant-based financial aid policy applies to admitted international undergraduate students; international students are not eligible for U.S. federal aid. Aid is awarded based on demonstrated need.
Scholarship_Value: Commits to meet 100% of demonstrated need with grant funds and work-study (loan-free, all-grant packages).

University: Cornell University
Scholarship: Cornell Grant / Scholarship Aid (international)
Scholarship_Type: Need-based grant; need-aware for international applicants
Conditions: International first-year and transfer applicants seeking Cornell grant aid must complete the CSS Profile at the time of admission. Undergraduate admission for international students is need-aware (need is one factor among many).
Scholarship_Value: Meets 100% of admitted international undergraduates' demonstrated financial need with Cornell grants, an annual work-study award, and reasonable student loans depending on total family income.

University: Brown University
Scholarship: Brown Need-Based Scholarship (international)
Scholarship_Type: Need-based grant (no-loan); need-blind for international from Class of 2029
Conditions: International students applying to enter in fall 2025 (Class of 2029) and later are considered need-blind; those admitted earlier or as transfers remain under the need-aware policy. The Brown Promise replaced loans with scholarship funds (2018).
Scholarship_Value: Meets 100% of demonstrated financial need; packages are loan-free (grants/scholarships only).

University: Dartmouth College
Scholarship: Dartmouth Need-Based Scholarship (international)
Scholarship_Type: Need-based grant; need-blind for all international (Class of 2026+)
Conditions: Need-blind admissions policy expanded to include all international citizens beginning with the Class of 2026. Scholarships include an allowance for travel to the U.S.; first-year international students have no summer earnings expectation, with a $1,500 student work contribution in later years.
Scholarship_Value: Meets the full demonstrated need of all admitted undergraduates including international students; aid award includes about $2,450 estimated annual term-time work income.

University: Northwestern University
Scholarship: Northwestern Need-Based Financial Aid (international)
Scholarship_Type: Need-based grant (loan- and work-free); need-aware for international applicants
Conditions: Need-aware admission review for international students; only first-year applicants are eligible and must apply for and receive aid in the first year to qualify in later years. Considers full cost of attendance including travel allowance.
Scholarship_Value: Meets 100% of demonstrated financial need for all four years; packages consist only of grants and scholarships (loan-free and work-free) that do not need to be repaid.

University: Duke University
Scholarship: Duke Need-Based Financial Aid (Financial Support)
Scholarship_Type: Need-based aid
Conditions: Must indicate financial-aid interest on the admissions application; international applicants requesting aid are reviewed in a separate admission pool; submit the CSS Profile by February 1. Students who decline aid interest are ineligible for institutional aid in any year.
Scholarship_Value: Meets demonstrated financial need (varies by family)

University: Johns Hopkins University
Scholarship: Hopkins Need-Based Scholarships for International Applicants
Scholarship_Type: Need-based scholarship
Conditions: No separate international application; all international citizens must submit the Certification of Finances (COF) form and follow the step-by-step need-based scholarship application instructions.
Scholarship_Value: Need-based scholarship covering demonstrated need (varies)

University: University of Chicago (UChicago)
Scholarship: UChicago International Financial Aid (need-based, loan-free)
Scholarship_Type: Need-based aid (grant)
Conditions: Available only to admitted first-year (non-transfer) international students who apply for funding during the admissions process; not available after admission or to international transfers. Submit the Student Financial Aid Worksheet (no CSS Profile/FAFSA).
Scholarship_Value: Meets 100% of demonstrated need with a loan-free package

University: University of Chicago (UChicago)
Scholarship: UChicago Merit Scholarships for International Students
Scholarship_Type: Merit-based scholarship
Conditions: All first-year applicants automatically considered; no additional application. Awarded for academic/extracurricular achievement independent of financial need. International transfer students are not eligible.
Scholarship_Value: Partial-tuition award (single lump-sum or renewable annual)

University: UCLA
Scholarship: UCLA Scholarship Application (institutional scholarships)
Scholarship_Type: Merit- and need-based institutional scholarships
Conditions: Complete the annual UCLA Scholarship Application by the priority deadline (newly admitted first-year by April 2, transfers by May 5). Federal/state need-based aid is generally unavailable to international students.
Scholarship_Value: Varies by award

University: UC Berkeley
Scholarship: Berkeley International Student Scholarships (incl. Regents' & Chancellor's Scholarship)
Scholarship_Type: Merit-based institutional scholarship
Conditions: No separate application required; all admitted undergraduate international students are automatically considered for the programs for which they are eligible. Federal and state aid is generally unavailable to international students.
Scholarship_Value: Varies; Regents' & Chancellor's is Berkeley's most prestigious undergraduate scholarship

University: University of Michigan-Ann Arbor
Scholarship: U-M Limited Institutional Scholarships for International Students
Scholarship_Type: Merit-based scholarship (limited)
Conditions: No federal financial aid available to international students and only limited scholarship funding; any scholarship consideration requires no additional application. Schools/colleges have very limited funding for undergraduate international students.
Scholarship_Value: Limited; varies by school/college (e.g., LSA four-year renewable scholarships)

University: New York University (NYU)
Scholarship: NYU Financial Aid & Scholarships (merit-based + limited need-based)
Scholarship_Type: Merit-based and limited need-based aid
Conditions: US federal aid is not available to international students; NYU considers international students for institutional scholarships and limited need-based aid (international applicants submit the CSS Profile rather than FAFSA). Award packages combine financial need and academic merit.
Scholarship_Value: Varies; partial to (rarely) full tuition

University: University of Southern California (USC)
Scholarship: USC Merit-Based Scholarships (Trustee, Presidential, Deans)
Scholarship_Type: Merit-based scholarship
Conditions: Need-based federal/university aid is limited to US citizens and eligible noncitizens; international students are eligible for merit-based scholarships, on/off-campus work, and private financing. Top merit awards may require a separate application and minimum GPA.
Scholarship_Value: Trustee: full tuition (4 yrs); Presidential: half tuition (4 yrs); Deans: partial tuition

University: University of Oxford
Scholarship: Clarendon Fund Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Fully funded, merit-based (graduate: Master's & DPhil)
Conditions: Open to applicants of all nationalities including Thai students; no separate application - automatically considered when applying for a graduate course by the December/January funding deadline; selected on outstanding academic merit and potential
Scholarship_Value: Full course fees plus an annual living-costs grant of at least GBP 15,009 (2025-26) for full-time scholars; about 140-200 new awards per year

University: University of Cambridge
Scholarship: Cambridge Trust International Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Full funding, merit-based (postgraduate/PhD)
Conditions: For applicants from countries other than the UK or Ireland (includes Thailand) who are highly ranked by their prospective department; no separate application beyond the Cambridge admission application; financial situation does not affect selection
Scholarship_Value: University tuition fee at the international rate, annual maintenance allowance and the Student Immigration Health Surcharge; approximately 63 awards per year

University: Imperial College London
Scholarship: President's PhD Scholarships
Scholarship_Type: Fully funded (doctoral/PhD), open to any nationality
Conditions: High-performing undergraduate or Master's students wishing to undertake a PhD at Imperial; open to applicants of any nationality including international/Thai students
Scholarship_Value: Full tuition fees plus a generous stipend for a 3.5-year PhD place

University: University College London (UCL)
Scholarship: UCL Global Scholarships (Undergraduate & Masters)
Scholarship_Type: Need-based support for international students (separate UG and Master's schemes)
Conditions: Open to international students from lower-income backgrounds; aims to widen access so the student body remains diverse; separate schemes for undergraduate and taught Master's study
Scholarship_Value: Support for living costs and/or tuition fees for the duration of the degree (Global Undergraduate award can cover 100% of tuition plus a living stipend for some recipients)

University: London School of Economics (LSE)
Scholarship: Graduate Support Scheme (GSS)
Scholarship_Type: Need-based (means-tested) partial award for taught master's/diploma
Conditions: Open to all applicants for diploma and taught master's study with Home or Overseas fee status (includes international/Thai students); assessed on financial need, not academic merit; intended to supplement existing funding
Scholarship_Value: Awards ranging from GBP 5,000 to GBP 20,000 depending on financial need (LSE provides around GBP 3 million per year)

University: University of Edinburgh
Scholarship: GREAT Scholarships (Thailand) / Edinburgh international postgraduate funding
Scholarship_Type: Partial, country-specific (postgraduate taught); plus wider international schemes
Conditions: In partnership with the British Council and the GREAT Britain Campaign, Edinburgh offers scholarships to students in Thailand (also Mexico and Ghana) applying for one-year postgraduate courses; the University also runs the Edinburgh Global Research Scholarship for overseas PhD students
Scholarship_Value: Partial award towards one-year postgraduate study for Thai students (GREAT Scholarship); Edinburgh Global Research Scholarship covers the overseas/home PhD tuition fee differential

University: King's College London (KCL)
Scholarship: King's Business School Postgraduate (MSc) Scholarships
Scholarship_Type: Merit/diversity-based partial award (taught master's)
Conditions: Open to the brightest students from around the world (includes international/Thai students); rewards academic excellence, diversity and ambition; applicants apply for the single scholarship that best represents them
Scholarship_Value: A portfolio of scholarships covering up to 50% of tuition fees, with others worth up to GBP 10,000

University: University of Manchester
Scholarship: Global Futures Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Merit-based partial award (undergraduate & master's), international students
Conditions: For self-funded international (overseas-fee) students from a selection of countries; awarded on academic excellence and online application responses; excludes certain courses (e.g. MBA, Medicine, Dentistry, Architecture)
Scholarship_Value: Undergraduate awards of GBP 8,000 per year (up to ~GBP 24,000 over three years); master's awards of GBP 15,000 - as a discount on overseas tuition fees

University: London Business School MBA
Scholarship: LBS MBA Scholarships (portfolio, incl. Laidlaw Women's Leadership Fund)
Scholarship_Type: Merit/need/diversity-based partial awards (MBA)
Conditions: Admitted MBA students are automatically considered for all internal awards; fees are the same for international and domestic students, so awards are open to international/Thai admits; some awards target specific groups (e.g. women via the Laidlaw Women's Leadership Fund)
Scholarship_Value: Partial awards varying by scholarship (set against 2026 MBA tuition of GBP 123,950); e.g. Laidlaw Women's Leadership Fund and other portfolio awards

University: ETH Zurich
Scholarship: Excellence Scholarship & Opportunity Programme (ESOP)
Scholarship_Type: Merit-based excellence scholarship (Master's)
Conditions: Open to students of all nationalities (Swiss and international); requires a top-10% bachelor's result (grade A); not eligible if already enrolled in or holding a master's degree; apply within the first application window (November) via eApply, including a self-developed master's thesis pre-proposal and two references
Scholarship_Value: CHF 12,000 per semester for living and study costs plus a full tuition fee waiver for the regular duration of the master's (3-4 semesters)

University: EPFL
Scholarship: EPFL Master's Excellence Fellowship
Scholarship_Type: Merit-based excellence fellowship (Master's)
Conditions: For the most outstanding incoming master's students (those with an EPFL bachelor's as well as those who began studies at another institution); awarded on remarkable academic results and distinction in extracurricular (sporting, artistic, civic or entrepreneurial) activities; candidates must tick the corresponding box on the master's application form and provide the requested application file
Scholarship_Value: CHF 10,000 per semester, together with guaranteed housing

University: TU Munich
Scholarship: Scholarship for International Students of TUM
Scholarship_Type: Merit- and need-based one-time financial aid (funded by the Bavarian government)
Conditions: For international students not eligible for BAfoeG due to nationality; from the 3rd semester of bachelor's or 2nd semester of master's studies at TUM (1st master's semester if the bachelor was completed at TUM). Requires good academic records and proven financial need; students may reapply each semester.
Scholarship_Value: One-time aid of EUR 500 to EUR 1,800 per semester (maximum funding period 36 months)

University: LMU Munich
Scholarship: SIST LMU Study Scholarship and Deutschlandstipendium
Scholarship_Type: Merit- and need-based (Bavaria/DAAD funded) plus merit-based Deutschlandstipendium
Conditions: SIST Study Scholarship is for registered international full-time students/doctoral candidates demonstrating academic excellence and financial need (applied for via the International Office). The Deutschlandstipendium is open to enrolled LMU students of all nationalities with excellent academic performance and above-average commitment.
Scholarship_Value: SIST Study Scholarship up to EUR 650 (max 10 months); Deutschlandstipendium EUR 300/month for one year

University: Heidelberg University
Scholarship: Deutschlandstipendium and Hans-Peter Wild Talent Scholarships (plus targeted international scholarships)
Scholarship_Type: Merit-based (Deutschlandstipendium and MINT/STEM talent award); additional targeted international scholarships
Conditions: Deutschlandstipendium is open to gifted students of all nationalities enrolled or admitted at Heidelberg, selected purely on merit (grades, social commitment, achievements; income not considered). Hans-Peter Wild Talent Scholarships support prospective BA/MA students of all nationalities in a MINT (STEM) subject. Other awards (Amirana, HAUS, Baden-Wuerttemberg-STIPENDIUM, DAAD STIBET) target specific international groups.
Scholarship_Value: Deutschlandstipendium EUR 300/month (min. 2 semesters); other awards vary

University: HEC Paris Grande Ecole
Scholarship: HEC Foundation Excellence Scholarship (plus need-based scholarships)
Scholarship_Type: Merit-based (tuition fee reduction); need-based aid also available
Conditions: Open to international students admitted to HEC Paris Master's (Grande Ecole) programs. Merit awards decided on academic excellence, overall application strength, interview performance and GMAT/GRE/TAGE-MAGE; all admitted applicants are automatically considered. International applicants may additionally apply for need-based scholarships.
Scholarship_Value: Awarded as a reduction of tuition fees (amount varies by award)

University: HEC Paris MiM Master
Scholarship: HEC Foundation Excellence Scholarship / merit-based Master in Management scholarships
Scholarship_Type: Merit-based (tuition fee reduction); eligible for external Eiffel Excellence Scholarship
Conditions: All applicants admitted into the HEC Paris Master's programmes are automatically considered for merit-based scholarships, judged on academic excellence and application strength. International applicants may also apply for need-based aid; the Eiffel Excellence Scholarship (French Ministry of Foreign Affairs) is available to international students.
Scholarship_Value: Tuition fee reduction (amount varies); external Eiffel adds a monthly stipend

University: HEC Paris MBA
Scholarship: HEC Paris MBA Scholarship for Excellence
Scholarship_Type: Merit-based (tuition fee reduction)
Conditions: Automatically considered for all admitted MBA candidates; awarded on academic excellence, professional achievements and leadership potential. Additional MBA awards target diversity and women (e.g. Forte Foundation, 30% Club).
Scholarship_Value: Up to 50% of tuition fees

University: Sciences Po
Scholarship: Emile Boutmy Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Merit-based excellence scholarship (tuition exemption/reduction)
Conditions: For first-time applicants to Sciences Po from a non-EU state whose household does not file taxes in the EU, admitted to an eligible Bachelor's or Master's programme. Awarded on merit; a separate scholarship request is made in the application's Financial Information section. Swiss/Norwegian and EU dual-nationals excluded.
Scholarship_Value: Bachelor's: full tuition exemption or EUR 9,500/year reduction. Master's: EUR 18,500/year exemption for each of the two years.

University: PSL Paris (Universite PSL)
Scholarship: PSL Graduate Programs Excellence Scholarships and PSL PhD Track grants
Scholarship_Type: Merit-based excellence grants; fully funded PhD tracks
Conditions: Open to international Master's and doctoral students. Excellence grants awarded on academic excellence and motivation (financial need considered in some cases); the highly selective PSL PhD Tracks combine a Master's and Doctorate over a fully funded 5-year programme taught in English.
Scholarship_Value: Excellence grants vary by programme; PSL PhD Tracks fully funded for the 5-year duration

University: Sorbonne Universite
Scholarship: France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship (university-nominated) and institutional financial assistance (FSDIE / fee exemptions)
Scholarship_Type: Government merit scholarship (Eiffel) plus institutional one-off aid
Conditions: International Master's and PhD applicants are nominated by Sorbonne University for the Eiffel Excellence Scholarship (students cannot apply directly). The university also offers fee exemptions, exceptional refunds and one-off financial assistance through the FSDIE solidarity fund.
Scholarship_Value: Eiffel: EUR 1,181/month (Master's), EUR 1,800/month (PhD) plus benefits; institutional aid varies

University: TU Delft
Scholarship: Justus & Louise van Effen Excellence Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Merit-based excellence scholarship (MSc)
Conditions: International students with a non-Dutch bachelor's degree, (conditionally) admitted to a 2-year TU Delft MSc programme; outstanding academic record (CGPA ~80%+ / top 10%); must submit the scholarship form and 2 reference letters together with the MSc application before the first deadline
Scholarship_Value: Full tuition fee waiver plus a contribution to living expenses (approx. EUR 30,000/year for non-EU/EFTA and EUR 11,500/year for EU/EFTA students) for the 2-year programme

University: University of Amsterdam (UvA)
Scholarship: Amsterdam Merit Scholarship (AMS)
Scholarship_Type: Merit-based scholarship (Master's, some Bachelor's)
Conditions: Open to outstanding students holding a non-EU/EEA passport who have applied for a degree programme at UvA; applications submitted to the Admissions Offices of the Graduate Schools; eligibility, selection criteria and deadlines differ per Faculty/Graduate School
Scholarship_Value: Varies by faculty: from full tuition fees plus a EUR 5,000 allowance (Business & Economics) to cash awards of EUR 15,000 (Science) or EUR 25,900 (Law); overall range approx. EUR 2,000-37,500

University: Bocconi University
Scholarship: Bocconi Merit Award
Scholarship_Type: Merit-based full tuition waiver (Bachelor's/MSc)
Conditions: Awarded to the top academic applicants admitted to a Bachelor or Master of Science programme; assessed automatically from the admission dossier (GPA, SAT/GMAT, CV, personal statement) with no separate scholarship application; international, Italian and current Bocconi students assessed in separate pools; renewable for the full programme if minimum credit requirements are met
Scholarship_Value: Full tuition waiver (approx. EUR 12,000/year undergraduate, EUR 13,000-14,000/year graduate), with possible free accommodation in a Bocconi Residence

University: SDA Bocconi MBA
Scholarship: Full-Time MBA Merit-Based Tuition Waivers
Scholarship_Type: Merit-based partial/full tuition waiver (MBA)
Conditions: Open to candidates who have submitted an application for the 2026-2027 Full-Time MBA; apply for the waiver on the online application portal by the round deadlines (multiple applications allowed); waivers from 60% require a minimum GMAT of 615, full waivers require a minimum GMAT of 645; selection based on academic/professional record and MBA selection results
Scholarship_Value: Grants ranging from 10% up to 100% of the EUR 82,000 programme cost (total scholarship budget of EUR 1,000,000)

University: Karolinska Institutet
Scholarship: KI Global Master's Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Tuition-fee scholarship (Master's)
Conditions: For tuition-fee-paying (non-EU/EEA) first-year students admitted to one of KI's global master's programmes; must have paid the application fee and fulfil entry/documentation requirements; separate scholarship application in February; highly competitive (about 1 scholarship per programme, ~10 awarded in 2025 from 687 applicants)
Scholarship_Value: Covers the full tuition fee (travel, living and other costs are not covered)

University: KU Leuven
Scholarship: Science@Leuven Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Merit-based partial tuition fee waiver (Master's, Faculty of Science)
Conditions: For talented international students admitted to a master's programme at the KU Leuven Faculty of Science; only students with excellent prior results (equivalent to at least a Distinction at KU Leuven) are considered; financed by the Science@Leuven Fund; highly competitive with a limited number available each year
Scholarship_Value: Partial tuition fee waiver - non-EEA recipients pay a reduced annual fee of EUR 1,426 regardless of programme

University: Trinity College Dublin
Scholarship: Global Excellence Postgraduate Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Merit-based partial tuition reduction (Postgraduate taught)
Conditions: For international (non-EU fee status) students who have a course offer for a full-time postgraduate taught programme in 2026/2027; business, engineering, natural sciences and computer science & statistics courses are excluded; students from China apply for the Claddagh Scholarship instead; apply online with a statement on contributing to the Trinity community; assessed on a rolling basis by region
Scholarship_Value: One-time reduction of the tuition fees of EUR 2,000-5,000 depending on the region

University: Tsinghua University
Scholarship: Chinese Government Scholarship (CGS / CSC)
Scholarship_Type: Full or partial, government (administered by China Scholarship Council)
Conditions: Non-Chinese citizen in good health; meets age/degree limits (Bachelor under 25, Master under 35, PhD under 40); HSK 4 for Chinese-taught or TOEFL/IELTS for English-taught; select Tsinghua as first priority. Open to international students including Thai. Type A applied via Chinese Embassy/Consulate, Type B via the university.
Scholarship_Value: Full CGS: tuition fees, free university dormitory or accommodation subsidy, comprehensive medical insurance, and monthly living stipend (approx. CNY 2,500 undergraduate / 3,000 master / 3,500 doctoral). Partial CGS covers one or some of these items.

University: Tsinghua University
Scholarship: Tsinghua University Institutional Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Partial/full, university-funded (alumni and corporate donations)
Conditions: International freshmen / degree-seeking international students at Tsinghua; encouraged to apply alongside the Chinese Government Scholarship per university announcements.
Scholarship_Value: University institutional scholarship supporting academic development and personal growth of international students; amount varies by award and donor.

University: Peking University
Scholarship: Chinese Government Scholarship (Type A and Type B)
Scholarship_Type: Full, government (China Scholarship Council)
Conditions: Non-Chinese citizen in good health; meets degree/age requirements; HSK for Chinese-taught or TOEFL/IELTS for English-taught programs; apply via PKU International Students Online Application System plus the CSC system. Open to international students including Thai.
Scholarship_Value: Tuition waiver, on-campus accommodation or living allowance, comprehensive medical insurance, and monthly living allowance (approx. CNY 2,500 undergraduate / 3,000 master / 3,500 doctoral).

University: Peking University
Scholarship: PKU Scholarship for International Students
Scholarship_Type: Full or partial, university-funded
Conditions: Degree-seeking international students at PKU (bachelor's, master's, PhD); listed among PKU institutional scholarships on the Office of International Relations / ISD scholarship page.
Scholarship_Value: Partial scholarship typically covers 100% tuition; full scholarship covers tuition, living stipend, accommodation expenses and comprehensive medical insurance.

University: Fudan University
Scholarship: Chinese Government Scholarship - Chinese University Program (Type B)
Scholarship_Type: Full, government (China Scholarship Council, Fudan Agency No. 10246)
Conditions: Non-Chinese citizen in good health; master's applicants under 35, doctoral under 40; must not hold any other Chinese government scholarship; apply via campuschina.org and Fudan's istudent portal selecting Fudan as the only Type B choice. Open to international students including Thai.
Scholarship_Value: Exemption from tuition fees, free on-campus accommodation or accommodation subsidy, comprehensive medical insurance, and living stipend (CNY 3,000/month master's, CNY 3,500/month doctoral).

University: Shanghai Jiao Tong University
Scholarship: Chinese Government Scholarship (CGS / CSC)
Scholarship_Type: Full, government (Type A via embassy, Type B via university)
Conditions: Non-Chinese citizen; undergraduate applicants apply via local Chinese Embassy/Consulate and select SJTU as first priority; graduate applicants may apply through SJTU (Type B) or embassies/consulates. Open to international students including Thai.
Scholarship_Value: Full scholarship covering tuition, stipend, comprehensive medical insurance; SJTU does not provide a free dormitory but provides an accommodation subsidy of CNY 1,100 per month.

University: Shanghai Jiao Tong University
Scholarship: Shanghai Government Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Partial/full, municipal government (Shanghai)
Conditions: International students applying to SJTU degree programs; administered via SJTU's prospective international student scholarships page alongside the CGS.
Scholarship_Value: Shanghai municipal scholarship supporting international students; coverage subject to the Shanghai Government Scholarship standard as listed on the SJTU scholarship page.

University: Zhejiang University
Scholarship: Chinese Government Scholarship - Chinese University Program (Type B)
Scholarship_Type: Full, government (China Scholarship Council)
Conditions: Full-time postgraduate (master's/doctoral) applicants who meet ZJU postgraduate admission qualifications; non-Chinese citizen; apply via the CSC Online Application System and ZJU. Application deadline December 31. Open to international students including Thai.
Scholarship_Value: Tuition waiver; free on-campus accommodation or accommodation allowance; living stipend per the relevant standard; comprehensive medical insurance.

University: Nanjing University
Scholarship: Chinese Government Scholarship - Nanjing University Postgraduate / High-Level Program (Type B, Agency No. 10284)
Scholarship_Type: Full, government (China Scholarship Council)
Conditions: Non-Chinese citizen in good health; master's applicants hold a bachelor's degree and under 35, doctoral applicants hold a master's degree and under 40; HSK 4-5 for Chinese-taught or IELTS 6.0/TOEFL 85 for English-taught; cannot hold another Chinese scholarship. Application period Jan 1 - Mar 31. Open to international students including Thai.
Scholarship_Value: Tuition waived, insurance fee covered, and monthly stipend of CNY 3,000 for master's and CNY 3,500 for doctoral students.

University: Nanjing University
Scholarship: Nanjing Government Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Partial, municipal government (Nanjing)
Conditions: International students at Nanjing University; application period March 1 - June 15; administered by the Institute for International Students. Open to international students including Thai.
Scholarship_Value: CNY 20,000/year for postgraduate and PhD students, CNY 10,000/year for undergraduate students, CNY 5,000/semester for non-degree students.

University: Nanjing University
Scholarship: Confucius Institute Scholarship (International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship)
Scholarship_Type: Full, government (Confucius Institute Headquarters / Hanban)
Conditions: For applicants to Chinese Language Advanced Study Programs or the Master's Program of Teaching Chinese to Speakers of Other Languages; non-Chinese citizen aged 16-35 with good academic record; application period March - May. Open to international students including Thai.
Scholarship_Value: Exemption from registration fees, tuition, basic learning material fees and on-campus accommodation fees; one-off resettlement subsidy, monthly living allowance, outpatient medical service and comprehensive insurance.

University: USTC
Scholarship: Chinese Government Scholarship (CGS)
Scholarship_Type: Full, government (Ministry of Education of China)
Conditions: Postgraduate (master's or PhD) applicants; non-Chinese citizen; apply online via the USTC ISA system. Deadline December to 15th of March. Open to international students including Thai.
Scholarship_Value: Waived tuition and free accommodation; monthly living allowance of CNY 3,000 - 3,500; comprehensive medical insurance.

University: USTC
Scholarship: CAS-TWAS President's Fellowship Program
Scholarship_Type: Full, fellowship (Chinese Academy of Sciences & TWAS)
Conditions: For PhD candidates; non-Chinese citizen; apply online via the USTC ISA system. Deadline December to end of March. Open to international students including Thai.
Scholarship_Value: Waived tuition; travel from home country to China (one trip per person); monthly living allowance of CNY 7,000 - 8,000.

University: USTC
Scholarship: USTC Fellowship / USTC Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Full or partial, university-funded
Conditions: For degree-seeking and exchange students; non-Chinese citizen; Scholarship A applicants must not be a CGS awardee and must meet degree/HSK/age limits; apply via the USTC online application system (isa.ustc.edu.cn). Open to international students including Thai.
Scholarship_Value: Tuition waiver and monthly stipend (Bachelor CNY 2,500 / Master CNY 3,000 / Doctoral CNY 3,500; up to ~CNY 7,000/month for top PhD candidates).

University: Wuhan University
Scholarship: Chinese Government Scholarship - Youth of Excellence Scheme of China Program (Type A, Agency code 1563)
Scholarship_Type: Full, government (China Scholarship Council)
Conditions: Non-Chinese citizen under 45 in good health; bachelor's degree or above with at least 3 years of work experience; government officials, senior managers, university/research administrators or those with international-organization experience; English-taught master's (Geospatial Information Technology or Public Health); TOEFL 80+/IELTS 6.0+. Apply via WHU online system before March 1 then CSC system before March 31. Open to international students including Thai.
Scholarship_Value: Full scholarship (tuition, accommodation, stipend and comprehensive medical insurance per CGS full standard) for a two-year '1+1' mode master's program.

University: Sun Yat-sen University
Scholarship: Chinese Government Scholarship (Bilateral, High-Level Graduate, Silk Road and Youth of Excellence Programs)
Scholarship_Type: Full, government (China Scholarship Council)
Conditions: Non-Chinese citizen in good health; bachelor's applicants under 25, master's under 35, doctoral under 40; HSK 3-5 for Chinese-taught or TOEFL 79/IELTS 6.5 for English-taught; apply via SYSU Office of International Students' Affairs and the CGS system. Open to international students including Thai.
Scholarship_Value: Full scholarship covering tuition, accommodation/living expenses, monthly stipend and comprehensive medical insurance (per CGS full standard).

University: Sun Yat-sen University
Scholarship: Silk Road - Chinese Government Scholarship Program
Scholarship_Type: Full, government (China Scholarship Council, Belt and Road)
Conditions: Applicants from 10 Belt and Road countries explicitly including Thailand; bachelor's (under 25), master's (under 35) or doctoral (under 40) holders with excellent academic records; HSK or TOEFL/IELTS as required; maximum 10 students admitted on competitive merit.
Scholarship_Value: Full Chinese Government Scholarship (tuition, accommodation, stipend and medical insurance) to pursue bachelor's, master's or doctoral degrees at SYSU.

University: Renmin University of China
Scholarship: Chinese Government Scholarship (Type A Bilateral and Type B High-Level/Silk Road, Agency No. 10002)
Scholarship_Type: Full, government (China Scholarship Council)
Conditions: Non-Chinese citizen; Type A applicants apply first to dispatching authorities (e.g. Chinese embassies) and select RUC as first choice; Type B applicants apply to both RUC and CSC simultaneously via studyinchina.csc.edu.cn. Open to international students including Thai.
Scholarship_Value: Full scholarship covering tuition, accommodation, living allowance and comprehensive health insurance.

University: Renmin University of China
Scholarship: Beijing Government Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Full or partial, municipal government (Beijing)
Conditions: Outstanding international students studying or conducting research at RUC / institutions in Beijing; opens for application at the beginning of the new semester.
Scholarship_Value: Covers full or partial tuition fees and comprehensive medical insurance.

University: Beijing Normal University
Scholarship: Chinese Government Scholarship - Chinese University Program (Type B, Agency No. 10027)
Scholarship_Type: Full, government (China Scholarship Council)
Conditions: Non-Chinese citizen; supports undergraduate and graduate students (bachelor under 25, master under 35, doctoral under 40); HSK for Chinese-taught or IELTS/TOEFL for English-taught; applicants should not hold any other scholarship; apply via BNU International Student Application System and CSC between November and March. Open to international students including Thai.
Scholarship_Value: Tuition, free university dormitory or accommodation subsidy, monthly stipend, and comprehensive medical insurance (per CGS full standard).

University: Beijing Normal University
Scholarship: BNU Scholarships (Beijing Government Scholarship, BNU New International Student Scholarship, 'Silk Road Muduo' Scholarship, Belt and Road School Scholarship)
Scholarship_Type: Full or partial, university and municipal-funded
Conditions: International students applying to BNU; apply online via the BNU International Students Online Service System and submit paper materials to BNU; eligibility per the latest BNU Admission Brochure. Open to international students including Thai.
Scholarship_Value: University/municipal scholarships covering full or partial tuition and related support; coverage varies by specific scholarship per the BNU admission brochure.

University: Tongji University
Scholarship: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) - High Level Postgraduate Program (Type B) & Tongji University International Student Excellence Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Government (CSC) administered by the university + university merit scholarship
Conditions: Non-Chinese citizens in good health; Master's applicants under 35 and PhD applicants under 40; cannot hold another Chinese government scholarship; apply via Tongji portal (agency no. 10247, Type B) plus CSC system
Scholarship_Value: Full tuition waiver, free on-campus accommodation (or housing subsidy RMB 700/month Master's, RMB 1,000/month PhD), living stipend RMB 3,000/month (Master's) and RMB 3,500/month (PhD), comprehensive medical insurance

University: Beihang University
Scholarship: Beihang University Foreign Students Scholarship (incl. Outstanding Talents Scholarship for Freshmen, Self-Supported & Distinguished Foreign Students Scholarship)
Scholarship_Type: University-funded scholarship for international students (alongside CSC and Beijing Government Scholarship)
Conditions: International (non-Chinese) students who meet Beihang admission requirements; awards include freshman 'Outstanding Talents', self-supported, distinguished, and program/cooperation scholarship categories; applied through the International School
Scholarship_Value: Tuition reduction/waiver and/or stipend depending on award category (full or partial; varies by scholarship tier and program)

University: Harbin Institute of Technology (HIT)
Scholarship: HIT International Students Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: University merit scholarship (tuition-waiver tiers)
Conditions: Non-Chinese citizens in good health; Bachelor's applicants under 25, Master's under 30, Doctoral under 35; no double benefits (cannot hold multiple scholarships); language proof required (HSK 4 >=210 for Chinese-taught or English certificate)
Scholarship_Value: Tuition-fee waiver tiers - Elite: 100% tuition waiver; First: 50% waiver; Second: 30% waiver; Third: 20% waiver

University: Xi'an Jiaotong University
Scholarship: XJTU Siyuan International Student Scholarship (plus CSC, Belt & Road and city scholarships)
Scholarship_Type: University scholarship for international students (alongside CSC Type B, agency no. 10698)
Conditions: Non-Chinese citizens; designated CSC university; XJTU Siyuan supports up to 2 years (Master's) / 3 years (PhD); CSC route open to all nationalities meeting age/health requirements, English proficiency certificate accepted
Scholarship_Value: Tuition-fee waiver plus monthly living allowance (Siyuan); CSC route adds full tuition, free accommodation, medical insurance and stipend RMB 3,000/month (Master's) and RMB 3,500/month (PhD)

University: Nankai University
Scholarship: Chinese Government Scholarship - Nankai University (Type B / University Program)
Scholarship_Type: Government (CSC) administered by the university
Conditions: Non-Chinese citizens in good health; apply via Nankai International Student Online Service System plus CSC Online Application System (agency no. 10055, Type B); recipients may not concurrently hold another Chinese government/Nankai scholarship; application period Oct 2025-Mar 2026
Scholarship_Value: Tuition waiver, free on-campus accommodation or accommodation subsidy, monthly stipend per standard, comprehensive medical insurance

University: Tianjin University
Scholarship: Peiyang Future Scholar Scholarship for International Students
Scholarship_Type: University-funded scholarship (School of International Education)
Conditions: Non-Chinese citizens with valid passport; PhD applicants hold a Master's degree and under age 40 (Master's applicants under 35); good health/conduct; HSK-5 (>=180) for Chinese-taught or IELTS 6.0/TOEFL 80 for English-taught; apply online at tju.at0086.cn; deadline May 31, 2026
Scholarship_Value: PhD: full tuition subsidy RMB 38,000/academic year, living allowance RMB 3,500/month, free on-campus accommodation (Master's: tuition subsidy RMB 30,000/year, RMB 3,000/month, free accommodation)

University: Southeast University
Scholarship: SEU Scholarship (Southeast University School Scholarship) plus Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC, agency no. 10286)
Scholarship_Type: University scholarship for international students (plus government CSC route)
Conditions: Non-Chinese citizens in good health; apply via SEU online system (fs.seu.edu.cn); HSK 4 (200+) for Chinese-taught programs or TOEFL 80/IELTS 6.0 for English-taught; Master's applicants under 35, PhD under 40; application period Nov 2025-May 2026
Scholarship_Value: SEU Scholarship: partial tuition plus monthly living allowance; CSC route: full tuition, free accommodation, medical insurance, stipend RMB 3,000/month (Master's) and RMB 3,500/month (PhD)

University: Sichuan University
Scholarship: Chinese Government Scholarship (Bilateral / University / Student Exchange Programs)
Scholarship_Type: Government (CSC) administered by the university
Conditions: Non-Chinese citizens; Bilateral Program open to undergraduates, postgraduates and scholars (apply via home-country dispatching authority); University Program for postgraduates selected/recommended by SCU; covers both major study and one-year Chinese language (preparatory) study
Scholarship_Value: Full scholarship: tuition waiver, accommodation, living stipend and comprehensive medical insurance (per CSC standards)

University: HUST
Scholarship: China Link Scholarship Program (CSC-funded) and Chinese Government Scholarship - Chinese University Program (Type B, agency no. 10487)
Scholarship_Type: Government (CSC) fully funded scholarship administered by the university
Conditions: Non-Chinese citizens in good health; China Link for general scholars (current UG/Master's, under 45) and senior scholars (PhD students/faculty, under 50) from CSC partner universities, 1-12 months; CGS University Program for Master's (Bachelor's, under 35) and PhD (Master's, under 40), GPA 3.0/4 or 75%+, HSK 4-5 or TOEFL 80/IELTS 6.0
Scholarship_Value: Full scholarship: tuition waiver, free on-campus accommodation, comprehensive medical insurance and monthly stipend (RMB 3,000 general scholars/Master's; RMB 3,500 senior scholars/PhD)

University: Australian National University (ANU)
Scholarship: ANU Chancellor's International Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Merit / International
Conditions: Automatically assessed for commencing international (overseas) students who receive an offer in an eligible undergraduate or postgraduate coursework program; selection by academic merit; no separate application; ~200 awards; some categories (e.g. South East Asia) eligible for the higher rate.
Scholarship_Value: 25% or 50% tuition fee waiver for the duration of the degree

University: University of Melbourne
Scholarship: Melbourne International Undergraduate Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Merit / Need / International
Conditions: For international students enrolling in a bachelor degree who are citizens of countries with GDP per capita of US$10,000 or less; automatic consideration on admission; ranked on final secondary/foundation results. (Note: 25% for awards before 2027; 20% from 2027.)
Scholarship_Value: 25% tuition fee remission for the duration of the course

University: University of Sydney
Scholarship: International student scholarships (incl. Sydney International Student Award and Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarships Scheme)
Scholarship_Type: Merit / International
Conditions: Range of scholarships for international undergraduate, postgraduate coursework and research students; over AUD $135 million in scholarships awarded each year; eligibility and application vary by award.
Scholarship_Value: Varies by award (e.g. tuition reductions, stipends; over AUD $135 million awarded annually)

University: UNSW Sydney
Scholarship: International Scientia Coursework Scholarship (PUCA1025)
Scholarship_Type: Merit / International
Conditions: UNSW's most prestigious international award; rewards high academic achievement plus leadership and extracurricular activity; for international students commencing full-time undergraduate or postgraduate coursework; separate application required.
Scholarship_Value: Full tuition fee support, or AUD $20,000 per year towards tuition for the minimum program duration

University: UNSW Sydney
Scholarship: International Student Award
Scholarship_Type: International
Conditions: For citizens of eligible countries commencing studies in 2026 or 2027 in undergraduate, postgraduate or UNSW College diploma programs; can be combined with other international scholarships.
Scholarship_Value: 20% contribution towards tuition fees for every year of the program

University: Monash University
Scholarship: Monash International Merit Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Merit / International
Conditions: International students from all countries who receive a full (unconditional) undergraduate course offer at a Monash campus in Australia are automatically considered; selected on academic achievement (~20 per year); must maintain a distinction (70%+) average.
Scholarship_Value: AUD $15,000 per annum (awards from 2026), up to AUD $75,000 for the degree duration

University: University of Queensland (UQ)
Scholarship: UQ International Excellence Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Merit / International
Conditions: For international students with an unconditional offer in an eligible undergraduate or postgraduate coursework program commencing in 2026 who achieve a competitive score among offer holders; automatic consideration; cannot hold another UQ fee reduction or full external scholarship.
Scholarship_Value: 25% reduction in tuition fees per semester for the duration of the program

University: University of Queensland (UQ)
Scholarship: International Onshore Merit Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Merit / International
Conditions: For international students who completed their most recent qualification in Australia (used for admission) and achieve a competitive score among offer holders; automatic consideration on application.
Scholarship_Value: AUD $10,000 tuition fee reduction (2 x AUD $5,000 across the first two semesters)

University: University of Western Australia (UWA)
Scholarship: Global Excellence Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Merit / International
Conditions: International students from all countries with an offer for an eligible 2026 undergraduate or postgraduate coursework course and an equivalent minimum ATAR of 85.00 (UG) or WAM of 65.00 (PG); automatically assessed by Admissions; value tiered by entry score.
Scholarship_Value: AUD $6,000-$12,000 per year; up to AUD $48,000 (UG, 4 years) or AUD $24,000 (PG, 2 years)

University: University of Adelaide
Scholarship: Adelaide Merit Scholarship (15%)
Scholarship_Type: Merit / International
Conditions: For international students starting an undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree who achieve a credit average (e.g. minimum ATAR 80, IB 28, GCE A levels score 9, or GPA 5.0/7.0); automatically awarded at offer; must maintain minimum GPA 4.5/7.0.
Scholarship_Value: 15% tuition fee reduction for the standard full-time duration of the program

University: University of Technology Sydney (UTS)
Scholarship: UTS Academic Excellence International Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Merit / International
Conditions: Automatically awards top commencing international students starting undergraduate or postgraduate coursework study on campus in Sydney; selected on academic merit; no separate application.
Scholarship_Value: 30% tuition fees scholarship for the standard course duration

University: University of Technology Sydney (UTS)
Scholarship: UTS Vice-Chancellor's International Undergraduate Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Merit / International
Conditions: For high-achieving commencing international undergraduate coursework students at UTS in Sydney; awarded on academic merit.
Scholarship_Value: Full tuition scholarship for the standard course duration

University: Macquarie University
Scholarship: Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarship (VCIS)
Scholarship_Type: Merit / International
Conditions: Competitive, merit-based award for full-time international students commencing an undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree with a minimum ATAR equivalent of 85 (UG) or WAM equivalent of 65 (PG); requires a full offer plus a short scholarship application form.
Scholarship_Value: Up to AUD $10,000 applied towards tuition fees (one-off award)

University: RMIT University
Scholarship: Academic Merit Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Merit / International
Conditions: Supports outstanding international students from Southeast Asia (incl. Thailand) entering eligible programs at RMIT in Melbourne; awarded on academic merit.
Scholarship_Value: 20% tuition fee reduction for eligible programs

University: Deakin University
Scholarship: Deakin Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Merit-based tuition fee reduction
Conditions: For high-achieving international students applying to a Deakin undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree; separate application required; automatic consideration for most other international scholarships based on academic merit.
Scholarship_Value: 100% or 50% tuition fee reduction for the duration of the degree

University: Queensland University of Technology (QUT)
Scholarship: International Merit Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Merit-based tuition fee reduction
Conditions: For prospective international undergraduate and postgraduate students who meet minimum academic standards; selected faculties only; no separate application required (assessed on course application).
Scholarship_Value: 25% of tuition fees for the full duration of the program

University: Curtin University
Scholarship: Curtin International Scholarship (Global Merit Scholarship)
Scholarship_Type: Merit-based tuition fee credit
Conditions: For international students; one-off credit towards tuition fees based on academic performance; assessed automatically by Global Admissions on course application.
Scholarship_Value: One-off credit of AUD$10,000, up to AUD$12,500 based on academic performance

University: Griffith University
Scholarship: Vice Chancellor's International Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Merit-based tuition fee reduction
Conditions: For exceptional international students applying for undergraduate and postgraduate coursework study; separate application with academic transcripts and personal statement required; must maintain eligibility each trimester.
Scholarship_Value: 50% of tuition fees

University: La Trobe University
Scholarship: La Trobe High Achiever Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Merit-based tuition fee reduction
Conditions: For high-achieving international students applying for an undergraduate or postgraduate course; automatically considered; value tiered by weighted average mark (WAM).
Scholarship_Value: Up to 25% reduction in course fees (25% for WAM 75+, 20% for WAM 70-74.9, 15% for WAM 60-69.9)

University: University of Wollongong (UOW)
Scholarship: University Excellence Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Merit-based tuition fee reduction
Conditions: For international students enrolling in any Australian campus undergraduate degree at UOW (exclusions apply); awarded on academic achievement.
Scholarship_Value: 30% reduction in tuition fees

University: University of Newcastle
Scholarship: International Excellence Scholarship 2026
Scholarship_Type: Merit-based tuition fee reduction
Conditions: For high-performing students commencing an eligible undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree from Trimester 1, 2026; no application required, awarded automatically with an offer to study.
Scholarship_Value: A dollar value equivalent to 20% of the gross annual international tuition fee, per year

University: University of Tasmania (UTAS)
Scholarship: Tasmanian International Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Merit-based tuition fee reduction
Conditions: For full fee-paying international students; automatically assessed at time of submitting International Student Application; provided satisfactory grades are maintained; some courses excluded (e.g. Medicine, Dementia Care, AMC Seafaring).
Scholarship_Value: 25% reduction in tuition fees for the duration of the course

University: Murdoch University
Scholarship: Murdoch International Welcome Scholarship
Scholarship_Type: Merit-based tuition fee reduction
Conditions: For international full fee-paying students from eligible countries commencing an eligible coursework degree at a Western Australian campus; no separate application required, applied automatically each teaching period; recipient must not hold another Murdoch scholarship.
Scholarship_Value: 20% tuition fee reduction for the duration of the program

University: US Public Schools (Resident)
Scholarship: No verifiable scholarship found (F-1 must pay full unsubsidized cost)
Scholarship_Type: Not applicable (no aid)
Conditions: F-1 attendance at public secondary (grades 9-12) schools may not exceed 12 months and the student must reimburse the school district the full, unsubsidized per-capita cost of education; F-1 visas cannot be issued for public primary/elementary schools. No public financial aid/scholarships for F-1 students.
Scholarship_Value: None; full tuition reimbursement required

University: US Public Schools (Intl F-1)
Scholarship: No verifiable scholarship found (F-1 must pay full unsubsidized cost)
Scholarship_Type: Not applicable (no aid)
Conditions: F-1 attendance at public secondary (grades 9-12) schools may not exceed 12 months and the student must reimburse the school district the full, unsubsidized per-capita cost of education; F-1 visas cannot be issued for public primary/elementary schools. No public financial aid/scholarships for F-1 students.
Scholarship_Value: None; full tuition reimbursement required

University: US Private Day Schools (NAIS Avg)
Scholarship: Need-Based Financial Aid (Independent School Grants)
Scholarship_Type: Need-based grant (limited merit awards)
Conditions: Aid is mostly need-based grants (no repayment) determined via a financial aid application and financial statements (often through SSS); merit scholarships are rare and usually for special talent. There is no income cutoff; families reapply annually.
Scholarship_Value: Varies from a small percentage to nearly full tuition; NAIS member schools awarded nearly $3.6 billion in need-based aid in 2024-2025

University: US Private Boarding Schools (TABS Avg)
Scholarship: Need-Based Financial Aid for International Boarding Students
Scholarship_Type: Need-based grant
Conditions: Many top US boarding schools offer need-based aid to international students (some meet 100% of demonstrated need regardless of citizenship); applicants who do not file US taxes submit home-country income documentation. Awards vary with school endowment and family profile.
Scholarship_Value: Varies; qualifying international families typically receive grants covering around 50% of total cost of attendance

University: UK State Schools (Resident)
Scholarship: Free state-funded education (no tuition fees; no scholarships needed)
Scholarship_Type: Government-funded free schooling (not a scholarship scheme)
Conditions: Foreign national children resident in the UK normally have the right to attend state-funded schools free of charge; children resident outside the UK need an immigration status permitting school study - a Child Student visa only allows study at a licensed independent (fee-paying) school, not a state school, so overseas families generally cannot use state schools by entering on a study visa
Scholarship_Value: Free (funded by the state); no tuition fees and therefore no scholarships/bursaries

University: UK Independent Day Schools (ISC Avg)
Scholarship: Scholarships and means-tested bursaries (ISC schools)
Scholarship_Type: Merit scholarships plus need-based bursaries / assisted places
Conditions: Many independent day schools offer scholarships to very able pupils and means-tested bursaries to pupils who demonstrate financial need; about a third of pupils at ISC schools are on reduced fees; bursaries are typically aimed at UK-resident families though some schools extend support to international pupils
Scholarship_Value: Merit scholarships typically a modest fee reduction (about 5-20%); means-tested bursaries can reach up to 100% of fees depending on family circumstances

University: UK Independent Boarding Schools (ISC Avg)
Scholarship: Boarding school scholarships and bursaries (ISC schools)
Scholarship_Type: Merit scholarships (academic, music, sport, art, all-rounder) plus means-tested bursaries
Conditions: Many independent boarding schools offer scholarships for academic or other excellence and means-tested bursaries for lower-income families; awards are open to UK and international students (e.g. Christ's Hospital, a boarding school where most pupils are on greatly reduced fees or pay nothing); bursaries require detailed financial disclosure
Scholarship_Value: Merit scholarships typically 5-50% of fees (some up to 100% when combined with a bursary); means-tested bursaries up to 100%; typical boarding fees ~GBP 30,000-45,000 per year

University: Germany Public Schools
Scholarship: DAAD Scholarships (German public universities are largely tuition-free)
Scholarship_Type: Government-funded (German Academic Exchange Service) scholarships; public universities charge no tuition, only a semester contribution
Conditions: DAAD scholarships are aimed primarily at international graduates, Master's students, doctoral candidates and postdocs for study and research in Germany, awarded on academic merit. Public universities in Germany generally charge no tuition fees to German, EU and non-EU students alike (only a small semester contribution).
Scholarship_Value: Typical monthly stipend EUR 992 (Master's/graduates) / EUR 1,300 (PhD), plus travel allowance, health insurance and study/research allowances

University: Germany Private/Intl Schools (Avg)
Scholarship: International school scholarships & need-based bursaries (e.g. Berlin Brandenburg International School, Frankfurt International School)
Scholarship_Type: Merit scholarships / need-based bursaries / fee reductions at K-12 private & international schools
Conditions: Offered directly by private and international schools in Germany's main hubs (Berlin, Frankfurt, Munich, Hamburg); awarded on academic merit and/or demonstrated family financial need; families apply after admission and submit report cards, references and financial documentation; deadlines typically January-March for an August/September start
Scholarship_Value: Typically 10-60% of tuition fees (academic awards ~10-40%, need-based bursaries ~20-60%); full fee coverage is rare

University: France Public Schools
Scholarship: France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship Program
Scholarship_Type: French government merit scholarship (Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs, managed by Campus France)
Conditions: For top foreign (non-French) students in Master's (up to age 29) and PhD (up to age 35) programmes in priority fields. Applications are submitted only by French higher education institutions, not directly by students. French public universities charge low, regulated tuition and scholarship holders are exempt from differentiated non-EU fees.
Scholarship_Value: Monthly stipend ~EUR 1,181 (Master's) / EUR 2,100 (PhD) plus travel, health insurance, housing assistance and cultural activities; tuition exemption at public universities

University: France Private/Intl Schools (Avg)
Scholarship: Institutional scholarships at French private/international schools (representative: INSEAD MBA Scholarships)
Scholarship_Type: Merit-based, need-based and 'spot' institutional scholarships
Conditions: Private/international schools in France (e.g. INSEAD, KEDGE) fund their own scholarships for admitted international students. INSEAD offers need-based, merit-based (by origin, background, leadership) and spot scholarships; candidates apply via the scholarship portal after submitting their admission application.
Scholarship_Value: INSEAD: 170+ scholarship funds, average award ~EUR 24,000 (about 41% of participants receive a scholarship)

University: Netherlands Public Schools
Scholarship: NL Scholarship (formerly Holland Scholarship)
Scholarship_Type: Government merit-based scholarship (Bachelor's/Master's)
Conditions: For non-EEA international students applying for a full-time bachelor's or master's at a participating Dutch higher education institution; must not already hold a Dutch degree; financed by the Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science together with the participating universities; each institution sets its own deadline
Scholarship_Value: EUR 5,000 one-time grant, received in the first year of study (not a full-tuition scholarship)

University: Netherlands Private/Intl Schools (Avg)
Scholarship: Dutch International Schools (DIS) government-subsidised tuition
Scholarship_Type: State subsidy / reduced tuition for K-12 international schools
Conditions: Subsidised places at Dutch International Schools are reserved for children of international/expat families temporarily working in the Netherlands (non-Dutch passport, or family returning from abroad); eligibility verified at admission; families who do not qualify, or who choose fully private international schools, pay the full private tariff
Scholarship_Value: Subsidised annual fee of approx. EUR 5,500-6,500 (primary/secondary) versus approx. EUR 20,000-30,000/year at fully private international schools

University: Australia Government Schools (Intl Avg)
Scholarship: NSW International Students Program (fee-paying enrolment, public schools)
Scholarship_Type: Government fee-paying program (limited/no scholarships)
Conditions: Australian government (public) schools enrol fee-paying international students on a subclass 500 student visa via state department International Student Programs (e.g. NSW DE International); scholarships are generally not offered and students pay full tuition fees plus enrolment costs. Representative example: NSW public schools, primary and secondary enrolment subject to school capacity.
Scholarship_Value: No general scholarship; full tuition fees payable (varies by state and year level)

University: Australia Independent (Private) Schools
Scholarship: Independent school scholarships (Academic/Music/Sport/All-rounder/Bursary via ACER CSTP)
Scholarship_Type: Merit and equity-based tuition remission
Conditions: Australian independent/private schools offer scholarships across categories (academic, music, sport, all-rounder, Indigenous, bursary); the ACER Co-operative Scholarship Testing Program (CSTP) is accepted by 120+ schools (sit once, apply to many); most academic applications close February to May for the following year's entry.
Scholarship_Value: Typically 25% to 100% tuition remission (up to 100% tuition plus boarding for major academic and Indigenous awards)

University: China Public Schools (Citizen)
Scholarship: No dedicated scholarship; access limited to fee-charging international departments of public schools
Scholarship_Type: State K-12 (compulsory) education - regulated admission, no specific aid scheme for foreigners
Conditions: Public primary/secondary education is tied to the hukou system and is primarily for local citizens; international (non-Chinese) students are generally restricted to designated international departments ('guojibu') of approved schools, which require filing with district education authorities and valid visa/residence documents
Scholarship_Value: Standard public schooling not free to most foreigners; designated international departments charge high tuition comparable to private institutions; no general scholarship/financial-aid program for international K-12 students

University: China Intl Private Schools (Beijing/Shanghai Avg)
Scholarship: School-administered merit scholarships and means-tested bursaries (representative landscape)
Scholarship_Type: Private/international school financial aid (each school sets its own scheme)
Conditions: International/private and bilingual schools in China (e.g., Dulwich College Beijing, YK Pao School Shanghai) typically award scholarships on academic, music, art or sports merit via entrance assessment, plus need-based bursaries; foreign-passport students apply directly to each school
Scholarship_Value: Varies by school; merit scholarships commonly 10%-50% tuition reduction and means-tested bursaries up to 100% of fees (combined awards may reach full fee coverage)
